pipeline.sentence_segmentation: per matched turn, concatenated in turn order
pipeline.quote_selection: most prefix words over all quotes, earliest quote on ties
pipeline.quote_occurrence: max token Jaccard with the opinion for trusted prefixes, first on ties
pipeline.semantic_unit_rule: N consecutive candidate sentences of one matched turn, stride 1, a turn with fewer than N sentences gives one unit with all of them; the encoder reads the sentences joined by a space, the evidence is the transcript span from the first sentence start to the last sentence end, sentences located in sequence inside the turn
pipeline.quote_extent_rule: trusted matches only: the evidence covers the sentence parts of the source turn from the prefix start to the end of the first quote suffix of 6, 4 or 3 words (trailing punctuation removed) found after the prefix end within max_span_ratio x quote length characters; without a suffix, as many sentence parts as the quote has, from the prefix sentence on

evidence.threshold_decision: legacy_random of utils.calibrate_udv_v2 cosine on window2 units of the 144 train hearings: rules.legacy_random.threshold 0.5015 (hearing bootstrap 95% CI 0.4858 to 0.5129), rounded to 0.50; artifacts/calibration/threshold_v2.json
evidence.unit_decision: window2 of E2 (retrieval_v1_report.json, train and validation only): the only unit kind that beats sentence on acc_at_1_minus_random with Holm p < 0.05 on one benchmark in both train and validation (masked_quotes: +0.097, Holm 0.007, and +0.179, Holm 0.017) and is never significantly worse than sentence (nli: +0.007 and +0.014, Holm 0.25 and 0.41); window3 is worse than sentence on nli train (-0.020, Holm 0.019). See bookworm/docs/adr/0006-udv-v2-windows-full-quotes-and-verifier.md
evidence.quote_extent_rule: trusted matches only: the evidence covers the sentence parts of the source turn from the prefix start to the end of the longest quote suffix of 6, 4 or 3 words found after the prefix within 2 x quote length characters; without a suffix, as many sentence parts as the quote has, from the prefix sentence on; never outside the turn

calibration.primary_rule_declaration: The udv_v1 declaration (configs/udv.toml, 2026-09-22) is kept for the report layout: masked_top1_youden is computed and reported. It does not choose the udv_v2 cut; adopted_rule does.
calibration.adopted_rule_declaration: Declared on 2026-09-28 in ADR 0006, before any window cosine of a calibration pair was computed: the udv_v2 cut is the legacy_random rule, the rule udv_v1 adopted, recomputed on window units of train hearings only; hard_negative, masked_hard_negative and masked_top1_youden are reported for comparison.
calibration.bootstrap_unit_reason: opinions of the same hearing share speakers, topic and transcript, so they are not independent; each bootstrap replicate resamples whole hearings and redraws the random negatives

verifier_calibration.score: primary_probability of laya_en_en:learned_cross_model_with_pt (E3x v2 final test), refitted on the NLI benchmark train split by utils.udv_verifier apply
verifier_calibration.declaration: Declared on 2026-09-28 in ADR 0006, before any verifier score of a calibration pair was computed: the UDV-premise cut is the midpoint of the 0.25 quantile of the primary probability on the positive pairs of threshold_v2 and the 0.75 quantile on their legacy_random negatives, train hearings only; the hard_negative variant is reported and not adopted.
